title: Battle of Kastella
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kastella", at revision 1370444918, opens: "Battle of Kastella was a military engagement during the Greek revolution of 1821 with a victorious outcome for the Greeks, in the context of Reşid Mehmed Pasha’s expedition in Attica which had as its ultimate goal the occupation of the Acropolis." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q28602668, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1827 battle of the Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
